description.en:
Tells whether a black fade (CMND_BLACK_FADE_OUT or CMND_BLACK_FADE_IN) is still in progress on a screen.
Screens use SCREEN_A (0, top), SCREEN_B (1, bottom) and SCREEN_AB (2, both).

true while the fade is in progress, false otherwise.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.
